```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(future)
library(here)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = FALSE)
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
load(here("data", "processed", "split_data.RData"))

qwk <- metric_tweak("qwk", kap, weighting = "quadratic")
f_macro <- metric_tweak("f_macro", f_meas, estimator = "macro")
f_micro <- metric_tweak("f_micro", f_meas, estimator = "micro")
model_metrics <- metric_set(qwk, f_macro, f_micro, bal_accuracy, accuracy, roc_auc)

train_data |> count(damage_grade)
```

```{r}
plan(multisession, workers = min(4, nrow(folds)))
```

## Baseline Cross-Validation

```{r}
model_xgb <- boost_tree(mode = "classification",
  trees = 100, learn_rate = 0.1, tree_depth = 3) |>
  set_engine("xgboost", nthread = 1)

workflow_xgb <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(base_recipe) |>
  add_model(model_xgb)

set.seed(42)
xgb_fit_cv <- workflow_xgb |>
  fit_resamples(resamples = folds, metrics = model_metrics)
xgb_baseline_metrics <- collect_metrics(xgb_fit_cv)
xgb_baseline_metrics
```

## Weighting

```{r}
weight_exponent <- 0.5
class_counts <- train_data |>
  count(damage_grade, name = "class_count")
weighted_train <- train_data |>
  left_join(class_counts, by = "damage_grade") |>
  mutate(case_weight = (nrow(train_data) / class_count)^weight_exponent,
    case_weight = hardhat::importance_weights(case_weight / mean(case_weight))) |>
  select(-class_count)

weighted_splits <- vector("list", nrow(folds))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(folds))) 
{
  split <- folds$splits[[i]]
  analysis_data <- analysis(split)
  class_counts <- analysis_data |>
    count(damage_grade, name = "class_count")
  analysis_data <- analysis_data |>
    left_join(class_counts, by = "damage_grade") |>
    mutate(case_weight = (nrow(analysis_data) / class_count)^weight_exponent,
      case_weight = hardhat::importance_weights(case_weight / mean(case_weight))) |>
    select(-class_count)
  assessment_data <- assessment(split) |>
    mutate(case_weight = hardhat::importance_weights(rep(1, n())))
  n_analysis <- nrow(analysis_data)
  weighted_splits[[i]] <- make_splits(list(analysis = seq_len(n_analysis),
    assessment = n_analysis + seq_len(nrow(assessment_data))),
    data = bind_rows(analysis_data, assessment_data))
}
weighted_folds <- manual_rset(weighted_splits, ids = folds$id)

weighted_recipe <- recipe(damage_grade ~ ., data = weighted_train) |>
  update_role(building_id, new_role = "id") |>
  step_rm(has_secondary_use, geo_level_2_id, geo_level_3_id) |>
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = FALSE) |>
  step_zv(all_predictors()) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
```

```{r}
initial_candidates <- 15

model_xgb_tune <- boost_tree(mode = "classification", trees = tune(),
  learn_rate = tune(), tree_depth = tune(), min_n = tune(),
  loss_reduction = tune(), sample_size = tune(), mtry = tune()) |>
  set_engine("xgboost", nthread = 1, counts = FALSE)

workflow_xgb_tune <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(weighted_recipe) |>
  add_model(model_xgb_tune) |>
  add_case_weights(case_weight)

parameters_xgb <- extract_parameter_set_dials(workflow_xgb_tune) |>
  update(trees = trees(c(100, 1500)),
    learn_rate = learn_rate(log10(c(0.01, 0.20))),
    tree_depth = tree_depth(c(2, 14)),
    min_n = min_n(c(2, 30)),
    loss_reduction = loss_reduction(c(0, 5), trans = NULL),
    sample_size = sample_prop(c(0.6, 1.0)),
    mtry = mtry_prop(c(0.3, 1.0)))

set.seed(42)
initial_grid <- grid_space_filling(parameters_xgb,
  size = initial_candidates, type = "latin_hypercube")
initial_grid
```

## Tuning Test

```{r}
set.seed(42)
xgb_initial_results <- workflow_xgb_tune |>
  tune_grid(resamples = weighted_folds, grid = initial_grid,
    metrics = model_metrics, control = control_grid(verbose = TRUE))
```

```{r}
bayes_iterations <- 25
control_xgb_bayes <- control_bayes(
  verbose = TRUE, verbose_iter = TRUE, no_improve = 10,
  seed = 42, parallel_over = "resamples")

set.seed(42)
xgb_tune_results <- workflow_xgb_tune |>
  tune_bayes(resamples = weighted_folds, initial = xgb_initial_results,
    param_info = parameters_xgb, iter = bayes_iterations,
    metrics = model_metrics, control = control_xgb_bayes)
```

## Tuning Results

```{r}
collect_notes(xgb_tune_results)
xgb_tuning_metrics <- collect_metrics(xgb_tune_results)
show_best(xgb_tune_results, metric = "qwk")
autoplot(xgb_tune_results, metric = "qwk", type = "performance")

best_xgb_parameters <- select_best(xgb_tune_results, metric = "qwk")
best_xgb_parameters
```

## Cross-Validation Results

```{r}
xgb_tuned_metrics <- xgb_tuning_metrics |>
  filter(.config == best_xgb_parameters$.config) |>
  select(.metric, .estimator, mean, n, std_err)

xgb_cv_comparison <- bind_rows(xgb_baseline_metrics |> mutate(model = "Unweighted baseline"),
  xgb_tuned_metrics |> mutate(model = "Mild-weighted Bayesian (depth 2–14)")) |>
  select(model, .metric, mean, std_err)

xgb_cv_comparison |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = c(mean, std_err))
```


```{r}
baseline_folds <- collect_metrics(xgb_fit_cv, summarize = FALSE) |>
  select(id, .metric, baseline = .estimate)

tuned_folds <- collect_metrics(xgb_tune_results, summarize = FALSE) |>
  filter(.config == best_xgb_parameters$.config) |>
  select(id, .metric, tuned = .estimate)

xgb_fold_comparison <- baseline_folds |>
  inner_join(tuned_folds, by = c("id", ".metric")) |>
  mutate(change = tuned - baseline)

xgb_fold_comparison |>
  group_by(.metric) |>
  summarise(mean_change = mean(change), folds_improved = sum(change > 0), folds_declined = sum(change < 0), .groups = "drop")
```

## Selected Model Cross-Validation

```{r}
best_xgb_workflow <- workflow_xgb_tune |>
  finalize_workflow(best_xgb_parameters)

set.seed(42)
xgb_selected_cv <- best_xgb_workflow |>
  fit_resamples(resamples = weighted_folds, metrics = model_metrics,
    control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE))

collect_notes(xgb_selected_cv)
xgb_selected_cv_metrics <- collect_metrics(xgb_selected_cv)
xgb_selected_cv_metrics
xgb_cv_predictions <- collect_predictions(xgb_selected_cv)
```

```{r}
xgb_cv_confusion <- xgb_cv_predictions |>
  conf_mat(truth = damage_grade, estimate = .pred_class)
xgb_cv_confusion
autoplot(xgb_cv_confusion, type = "heatmap")
xgb_cv_confusion_counts <- as_tibble(xgb_cv_confusion$table)
```

```{r}
xgb_cv_per_class <- tibble()
for (class_level in levels(train_data$damage_grade)) {
  class_predictions <- tibble(
    truth = factor(xgb_cv_predictions$damage_grade == class_level,
      levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)),
    estimate = factor(xgb_cv_predictions$.pred_class == class_level,
      levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)))

  class_metrics <- tibble(class = class_level,
    precision = precision(class_predictions, truth, estimate, event_level = "first")$.estimate,
    recall = recall(class_predictions, truth, estimate, event_level = "first")$.estimate,
    f1 = f_meas(class_predictions, truth, estimate, event_level = "first")$.estimate)
  xgb_cv_per_class <- bind_rows(xgb_cv_per_class, class_metrics)
}

xgb_cv_per_class
```

```{r}
plan(sequential)
```

## Final Model

```{r}
set.seed(42)
final_xgb_fit <- best_xgb_workflow |>
  fit(data = weighted_train)
```

## Holdout Evaluation

```{r}
xgb_holdout_predictions <- augment(final_xgb_fit, new_data = test_data)
xgb_holdout_metrics <- model_metrics(
  xgb_holdout_predictions,
  truth = damage_grade,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  .pred_high, .pred_medium, .pred_low)
xgb_holdout_metrics
```

```{r}
xgb_holdout_confusion <- xgb_holdout_predictions |>
  conf_mat(truth = damage_grade, estimate = .pred_class)
xgb_holdout_confusion
autoplot(xgb_holdout_confusion, type = "heatmap")
```

```{r}
xgb_per_class <- tibble()
for (class_level in levels(test_data$damage_grade)) {
  class_predictions <- tibble(
    truth = factor(xgb_holdout_predictions$damage_grade == class_level,
      levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)),
    estimate = factor(xgb_holdout_predictions$.pred_class == class_level,
      levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)))

  class_metrics <- tibble(class = class_level,
    precision = precision(class_predictions, truth, estimate, event_level = "first")$.estimate,
    recall = recall(class_predictions, truth, estimate, event_level = "first")$.estimate,
    f1 = f_meas(class_predictions, truth, estimate, event_level = "first")$.estimate)
  xgb_per_class <- bind_rows(xgb_per_class, class_metrics)
}

xgb_per_class
```

## Save Results

```{r}
results_dir <- here("results", "metrics", "xgboost_final")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
testing_dir <- here("testing", "xgboost_final")
dir.create(testing_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(best_xgb_parameters, file.path(testing_dir, "best_parameters.rds"))
write_csv(best_xgb_parameters, file.path(results_dir, "best_parameters.csv"))
write_csv(xgb_cv_comparison, file.path(results_dir, "cv_metrics.csv"))
write_csv(xgb_fold_comparison, file.path(testing_dir, "fold_comparison.csv"))
write_csv(xgb_selected_cv_metrics, file.path(testing_dir, "selected_cv_metrics.csv"))
write_csv(xgb_cv_confusion_counts, file.path(testing_dir, "cv_confusion_counts.csv"))
write_csv(xgb_cv_per_class, file.path(results_dir, "cv_per_class_metrics.csv"))
write_csv(xgb_holdout_metrics, file.path(results_dir, "holdout_metrics.csv"))
write_csv(xgb_per_class, file.path(results_dir, "per_class_metrics.csv"))
```
